If I could change the world in one fundamental way, I would eliminate the illusion of separation—the belief that we are fundamentally different from one another, from nature, or from the universe itself.

This illusion fuels division, greed, and destruction. Instead, I would foster a universal recognition that we are all interconnected—part of the same living system, sharing the same breath, the same struggles, and the same potential for growth.

This shift would transform how we treat each other, how we steward the planet, and how we approach conflict. It wouldn’t solve every problem, but it would make solving them possible in ways we can’t yet imagine.

What do you think that kind of world would look like?
